system.description:
You are adept at staying out of sight when attacking from hidden positions.

Prerequisites: Sniper, Trained in Stealth, Base Attack Bonus +9

Effect: When you make a ranged attack against a target that is unaware of you, you gain a +2 bonus on your attack roll and deal +1 die of damage on the first attack each turn.

prerequisite.text: Sniper feat, Trained in Stealth, and Base Attack Bonus 9
